correctness.rationale: The full original anti–Rota–Baxter identity is equivalent, by testing all coordinate idempotent pairs, to \(r_{is}r_{it}+r_{it}r_{ts}+r_{is}r_{st}=0\) for all triples. At i=s=t it forces \(3r_{ss}^2=0\); at s=t it forces \(r_{is}(r_{is}+2r_{ss})=0\). Outside characteristic three, \(R=0\). In characteristic three, every nonzero column has one nonzero weight and a 0/weight support; paired column equations imply identical or disjoint supports and hence the unique claimed weighted-block normal form. Direct substitution proves sufficiency, independence of disjoint image supports yields exact rank, and evaluation of the three-variable strong identity gives diagonal rigidity. Choose active coordinates and Stirling blocks to enumerate all ranks; ordinary labeled-partition exponential enumeration proves the EGF and its inclusion–exclusion coefficient formula. Square-zero occurs exactly when each active block weight sum vanishes, with exact \(W_c(q)\) by recurrence. The separate standalone verifier tests every matrix (including the GF(9) extension field) for cases \((q,n)=(2,2),(3,1),(3,2),(3,3),(5,2),(9,2)\) and agrees with all formulas. Computations are finite independent checks, not substitutes for the proof.

originality.rationale: The genuine novelty assessed is an all-dimensional classification and finite-field rank/square-zero census of anti–Rota–Baxter operators on split reduced coordinate products, with characteristic-three-only nonzero solutions. The identity and strong subclass originate in Gao–Liu–Bai 2022; the different ordinary Rota–Baxter equation on the same underlying algebra is treated by Gubarev 2018. Read portions of both primary PDFs contain the identities and results used for the implication comparison and do not yield the claimed anti–Rota–Baxter enumerator. Indexed characteristic-three results concern dual numbers, and indexed splitting counts concern ordinary nonzero weight. Exact matching published-finding corpus records were not retrieved on several direct alias and parameter queries. Unsearched or unknown averaging-operator classifications are a residual publication-priority risk; absence from semantic search is not proof of global novelty.

value.rationale: The first natural reduced semisimple family \(k^n\) exhibits an exact characteristic-three-only jump from total zero rigidity to a rich all-rank algebraic classification. The explicit disjoint weighted-block structure is a complete normal form for every n and every field, and the finite-field rank and square-zero generating functions provide two different natural invariants rather than an arbitrary low-dimensional slice. Determining the strong/invertible subsets explains precisely when these anti-operators yield the stronger anti-dendriform construction. The result is motivated by the foundational anti-operator identity and the established product-of-fields operator literature. It does not rely on finite computation or novelty alone for value.
